WITH principal AS ( SELECT mm.smaller_amount as Mini, it.dian_code as A, rp.vat as B, rp.l10n_co_verification_code as C, rp.lastname1 as D, rp.lastname2 as E, rp.name1 as F, rp.name2 as G, rp.name as H, ( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'I' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'I' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'I' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.credit-aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'I' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as I, ( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.credit-aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'J' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as J, ( CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.credit-aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'K' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as K FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id inner join ( select aammlcr.account_account_id as account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id as concept_id from account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr union all select aaat.account_account_id as account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids as concept_id from mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat inner join account_account_tag aat on aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids inner join account_account_account_tag aaat on aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) as aa on aa.concept_id = mmlc.id INNER JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = aml.partner_id LEFT JOIN l10n_latam_identification_type it ON it.id = rp.l10n_latam_identification_type_id LEFT JOIN res_country_state rcs ON rcs.id = rp.state_id LEFT JOIN res_city rcsc ON rcsc.id = rp.city_id LEFT JOIN res_country rc ON rc.id = rp.country_id WHERE mm.id = {id} AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY mml.code, it.dian_code, rp.vat, rp.l10n_co_verification_code, rp.name1, rp.name2, rp.lastname1, rp.lastname2, rp.name, mmlc.sequence, mmlc.type, mm.smaller_amount ) SELECT A as "Tipo documento", B as "Número identificación del informado", C as "DV", D as "Primer apellido del informado", E as "Segundo apellido del informado", F as "Primer nombre del informado", G as "Segundo nombre del informado", H as "Razón social del informado", SUM(I) as "Impuesto (iva) generado", SUM(J) as "IVA recuperado por operaciones en devoluciones en compras anuladas, rescindidas o resueltas", SUM(K) as "Impuesto al consumo generado" FROM ( SELECT A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, SUM(I) AS I, SUM(J) AS J, SUM(K) AS K FROM principal GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, Mini -- HAVING SUM(I) >= Mini::float
-- UNION
-- SELECT -- '43' as A, -- '222222222' as B, -- '7' as C, -- '' as D, -- '' as E, -- '' as F, -- '' as G, -- 'CUANTIAS MENORES' as H, -- SUM(I) as I, -- SUM(J) as J, -- SUM(K) as K -- FROM ( -- SELECT Mini, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, SUM(I) AS I, SUM(J) AS J, SUM(K) AS K -- FROM principal -- GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, Mini -- HAVING SUM(I) < Mini::float --) AS cm --GROUP BY Mini ) AS datos GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H ORDER BY B -- HAVING SUM(I) > 0
